{{Short description|Statistical amount}}

'''Weighted average''' is a single number or value that best represents a set of data, when each data point is assigned different "weights" or importance. The most common weighted [[average]] is the ''[[weighted arithmetic mean]]'', which is similar to an ordinary [[arithmetic mean]] except some data points contribute more than others. Other cases include the [[weighted geometric mean]] and [[Harmonic mean#Weighted harmonic mean|Weighted harmonic mean]].
